query:
WITH WealthByRegion AS (
    SELECT 
        hl.region,
        COUNT(*) AS total_households,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN wi.wealth_level = 'Rich' THEN 1 END) AS rich_households
    FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index wi
    JOIN estishraf_llm_home_location hl ON wi.head_of_household_id = hl.id
    WHERE hl.region IS NOT NULL AND hl.region != ''
    GROUP BY hl.region
),
WealthPercentage AS (
    SELECT 
        region,
        (rich_households * 100.0 / total_households) AS rich_percentage
    FROM WealthByRegion
),
input AS (
    SELECT 
        region AS Region,
        rich_percentage AS RichPercentage
    FROM WealthPercentage
    ORDER BY rich_percentage DESC
)
SELECT input.*, poly.wkt FROM input JOIN ESTISHRAF_LLM_KSA_Regions_Polygons poly ON input.Region = poly.region
